source_of_truth.split_integrity: group-level source/target split guards; frames/cycles are not independent site units
source_of_truth.accepted_output: external receipt/adjudication reference under the declared acceptance profile
source_of_truth.safety: external, non-compensable; not scored by transfer evaluator

limitations: No inference of safety from productivity
No field-transfer claim from synthetic fixtures
No causal claim without matched/randomized design and appropriate independent units

accounting.budget_vs_actual: separate objects; actual labels/person-hours must not exceed declared budgets
accounting.work_item_separation: source and target-evaluation tasks disjoint; target-adaptation tasks and target-evaluation tasks disjoint
accounting.terminal_dispositions: finally accepted + finally rejected + uninspected + unresolved cannot exceed attempted units

regime_rules.zero_shot: source and target model digests and robot configuration digests must match; no target labels or calibration-change receipt
regime_rules.calibration_only: model/policy digest remains identical; any robot-configuration digest change requires an explicit calibration receipt; no target task labels
regime_rules.bounded_offline_adaptation: target labels and actual adaptation effort must remain within separately declared budgets
regime_rules.human_supervised_method_adaptation: engineering effort must be recorded and bounded by declared budget
